metadata.name: Retail Technology Blueprint
metadata.description: Retail Technology Blueprint v5 - capacidades L3 para retail. Equivalente del Banking ETB. Fuente: Accenture SME Industry Retail.

capabilities.description: External facing websites to enhance brand awareness, share product information to support sales, carry out marketing initiatives and manage other customer facing activities
External facing mobile friendly websites to enhance brand awareness, share product information to support sales, carry out marketing initiatives and manage other customer facing activities
Mobile applications to support sales, marketing and other customer facing activities, through applications designed to run on the handheld devices.
Capability enabling collecting data from the physical environment, by means of edge devices or wearables, and executing actuating commands basis insights drawn from the collected data

Capability enabling centralized service unit in receiving or transmitting large volume of phone calls where consumers can reach out for product enquiries, buying assistance, service against the sales, etc.  IVR capability enables automated telephony system that can interact with caller basis rule-based workflow, can capture the required information, interact with the internal IT systems via interfaces and can route the calls to the appropriate contact center agent basis the defined rules.

Capability enables companies in managing transactions and communication with its Business partners like distributors, agents, customers, etc. Companies that interact with large numbers of partners across operational areas are most likely to implement this type of collaboration platform.

Online marketspace provides platform to multiple third parties to register and sell their products or services. Platform in this case is generally provided by the third party and may not be directly owned by the retailer.

Commerce engine enables managing online sales for consumers or customers. Functions include creation and management of Web storefronts, shopping cart, personalization, payment transactions & settlements, product visualization etc.

Capability enables making sales and managing marketing through social networks. It leverage social networks, social media content and relationships with consumers to drive to drive measurable, repeatable and scalable sales transactions. Enables the retailers to understand what consumers are saying about brand and how the information can be leveraged to unlock growth potential.
Capability which leverages Artificial Intelligence with aim to convincingly imitate human behaviors in conducting automated conversation with customers.

Capability enabling usage of technology to immediately supply relevant information to customers and employees in a way that is instantly applicable to a given task or situation, utilizing virtual graphics, textual annotations, auditory information and haptic (touch) sensations in a coordinated real-time presentation.

Leverages instant messaging capability for communication with the customers. Many such solution apps have developed into broad platforms enabling status updates, chatbots, payments and conversational commerce.
Form of communication to manage interaction with customers to keep them informed about product, trigger targeted communications and promotions, seek feedback, etc.

This business capability leverages data analytics and machine learning to provide personalized product recommendations to customers. It enhances the shopping experience by suggesting relevant products based on customer preferences, browsing behavior, and purchase history.

This business capability offers customers a virtual assistant to guide them through their shopping journey. It uses artificial intelligence to provide real-time assistance, answer queries, and offer product recommendations, creating a convenient and personalized shopping experience.

Digital platforms where businesses pay to promote their products or services to a targeted audience. These channels include advertising methods such as search engine ads, social media ads, display ads, and affiliate marketing. Paid channels allow retailers to increase visibility, drive traffic, and generate sales by reaching potential customers through strategically placed ads on platforms like Google, Facebook, Instagram, and other websites. These ads are typically targeted based on user behavior, demographics, and interests, providing retailers with an effective way to engage and convert specific customer segments.

Streaming Platforms involve digital channels like YouTube,  Spotify, etc where brands engage customers through live or on-demand video and audio content. Retailers use these platforms for live product demos, interactive shopping events, advertising, and brand storytelling. Streaming allows for direct consumer engagement, creating immersive experiences that drive sales. These channels help retailers increase brand visibility, foster customer interaction, and build stronger emotional connections, making them an essential tool in modern retail marketing strategies.

Capability to enable retailer’s staff to complete customer sale transactions across all points of sale e.g. store, ecommerce, call center channel etc. POS solutions supports providing rich interactive experiences for consumers by leveraging PIM, sales and payment, gift registry, loyalty, product reservation, etc.

Capabilities to enable self-service for customers like option to retrieve product information, scan products and make payments without the direct involvement of the retailer’s staff. Kiosk solutions enable the retailer to deliver rich interactive experience directly to customers through a diverse suite of applications.

Capability enabling customers to interact with service stations to receive a service from an organization against the product or service procured or to be procured. Also for service stations it enables to register and manage service requests for customers. It also includes registering and providing in-home service to customer both at pre- and post-sales stage. E.g. in case of furniture Retailer, inhouse visit be made for the purpose of taking measurements.
Capability to enable management of performance-based marketing in which an affiliate is rewarded for bringing customers through their own efforts.

Capability to manage the digital signboards by supporting the creation, management and distribution of digital signage content, e.g. creating playlists, pushing the content to different digital signs etc.
Capability to manage automated machine that gives out usually small products such as snacks, drinks, cigarettes when a payment is received in the form of coins / cash, tokens, contactless cards, etc.

Capability to support management of personalized service geared more towards loyal consumers conducted by specific brand ambassadors and that includes in-home visits and follow-ups, recording results and outcomes analysis with the aim of selling products and / or services.
Capability supporting creation, curation and publication of advertisements that are printed in hard copies like newspaper, magazines, pamphlets, etc.
Capability enabling form of marketing that involves sending a physical piece of promotional material through postal service to a home or business.

Curbside refers to a retail service where customers can place an order online and then pick it up directly from the store. Typically, customers drive to a designated curbside parking area, where store staff bring their pre-ordered items to the vehicle. This service is popular in the retail and grocery sectors, offering convenience and safety, Curbside pickup allows retailers to serve customers efficiently while reducing in-store traffic and providing a contactless shopping experience.

Journey Design focuses on creating seamless, personalized, and impactful interactions throughout the customer’s path with a retail brand. It involves mapping out every touchpoint, from initial awareness to post-purchase engagement, ensuring consistency and relevance.
4o mini

Capability which leverages analytics, user research and design thinking to identify UX and product related problems and performs experimentation so to identity how different options can influence the user reactions and outcomes to come up with the right experience design deriving optimum value for the organization.

Capability enabling options to carry out market research for different purposes like capturing market point of view, customer demographics understanding, feedbacks and surveys, etc. Also enables with tools and technologies for quantitative techniques of market research like conducting surveys including compilation of data from market research.

Capability enabling planning and tracking of marketing strategies, tactics, costs and projected results over a period of time. Marketing budgeting enables keeping track on specific goals like projected output, cost against defined allocation.

Campaign Management enables execution of marketing programs and campaigns based on marketing and customer strategies. Additionally campaign performance analysis is used by the marketers to justify the dollars spent on a particular campaign.

Capability to have automation of marketing activities by creating the workflows for execution of the activities like sending out automated communication to the prospects, subscribing user to the newsletter / communication mailers, periodic follow-ups, etc.

Search engine optimization enables growing the quality and volume of website traffic by increasing the visibility of a website or a web page to users of a web search engine. SEO refers to the improvement of unpaid results and excludes direct traffic and the purchase of paid placement.

Digital Asset Management facilitates effective and efficient management of any digital content. Enables with central platform to store content from disparate sources (internal & external) in a centralized repository and deliver it to various channels (including stores, web, mobile, print) under controlled automated publishing.

MRM enables with capability to orchestrate and optimize internal and external marketing resources. Enables retailer to create and manage marketing programs and content, build and manage knowledge base, distribute marketing assets, content and collateral, etc.

Affiliate marketing enables management of entire affiliate management cycle, from pre-launch to campaign management. This includes management of Merchant Affiliate Programs, Affiliate Ad Networks, Performance Ad Marketplace (campaign distribution), OEM Partner Management, Affinity and Loyalty Programs, etc.

Print management provides capabilities needed to create, manage and maintain all product and promotional content in one central repository which allows quick and easy publishing to Web, Print and CDROM catalogs.

Capability enables managing communication over social media channels like Facebook, Instagram etc. Also enables with capability for tracking reviews / comments / feedback / brand tagging over social media channels. Helps in engaging and retaining customers with this new form of digital marketing.

Capability to manage external marketing efforts that involve a paid placement. Paid media includes PPC advertising, branded content, and display ads. Paid media is an essential component of revenue growth and brand awareness for online businesses.

Capability enabling large Retailers to host / provide an Ad Network for advertisers to register and publish their advertisements on the Retailers platform (like Retailer websites, portals, etc.). Capability typically also provide with option to match the requirements of the advertisers and publisher to host the right advertisement depending on various factors like customer profile, platform context, etc.

Capability enabling business to create content for their marketing initiatives which can include written content, images, infographics, videos, etc. It manages the complexity and scalability requirements related to providing the content in different formats, supporting different types of platforms (like Android, iOS), scaling content for different screen sizes, and adaptability to different platforms (like mobile app, web portal, etc.).  Also enables collaboration between marketing team members (like writers and editors) and help to plan, track, and manage activities by both internal and external parties involved in the development of content.

It is a process of organizing, storing, and managing digital media assets like images, videos, graphics, and audio files. It involves using specialized software to efficiently track, retrieve, and distribute these assets across various marketing channels. MAM systems help retailers streamline content creation, ensure brand consistency, and facilitate collaboration among teams. By centralizing media assets, retailers can easily access and reuse content for campaigns, online stores, advertisements, and social media, improving efficiency and reducing duplication of efforts.

Application set capturing leads generating from different channels for prospective consumer interest or inquiry into a business' products or services through mobile & web (site visits, social media, etc.). Leads can be generated for a variety of purposes - list building, e-newsletter list acquisition, building out reward programs, loyalty programs, or other member acquisition programs

Application capabilities enabling management of complete data of the customers which provides end to end view of its complete lifetime. Enables capability of establishing and growing relationship with a customer once they purchase the product / service. This data is critical for providing insights for growth opportunities for the account such as upselling / cross-selling to existing customers, satisfying the customers for long term contract renewal, managing customer-sales support relationship etc.

Capability to build and maintain continued relationships with the consumer and repetitive positive experiences over time. It includes recognizing, rewarding and servicing consumers. It aims at developing and managing activities and programs aimed at encouraging and rewarding loyal buying behavior.

Capability to capture user feedback at various stages of the journey and across different channels in order to assess how effective its marketing, product and service efforts are and whether they can attract correct consumer / customer segments.

It is a strategic process of building and maintaining a strong brand presence in the market. It involves defining the brand's identity, values, and positioning, and then executing marketing initiatives that reinforce these aspects across various customer touchpoints. This includes consistent messaging, visual branding, and customer experiences that align with the brand’s mission and appeal to the target audience.

It involves strategic efforts to increase brand awareness, build customer loyalty, and differentiate the brand from competitors. Brand enhancement is about consistently refining and evolving the brand’s overall presence and reputation across all customer touchpoints, both online and offline.

Capability that enables managing the retailer to maintain the complete details of the products along with variants as SKU in a format consumable to the consumer / customer to understand the product / service range available to place the order

Product and offer recommendation engines use a retailer's product catalog and sales history to determine items for cross-sell or up-sell during an online sales transaction at or before the time of check-out. The product recommendation engines are predominantly used on e-commerce sites, but this technology is expanding into display ads, augmented reality and context-aware applications.

Capability for managing customer’s feedback on the products / services in form of user reviews, product ratings, etc. This information can be leveraged for generating actionable insights like understanding purchase behavior, user preferences, etc.
Solution to manage content specifically for web. It provides website authoring, collaboration, and administration tools

Capability that enables event based (or trigger) marketing campaigns in order to enhance the value of the contacts through real time/near to real time customer specific treatment and deep analytical insights.
Capability to manage creation of random codes for purpose of running the promotions as well as for validating the claims against the issued unique code.

Capability to let customers make customization to the product basis the predefined customization levers and capture the information for processing the order. Enables retailer to personalize the offerings according to customer’s preferences and needs

Capability enables execution of pricing and promotion parameters on the final basket of the consumer / customer basis the profile and other set factors to generate the amount to be settled against the retail transaction
Capability that helps manage the end to end process of selling and billing products and or services on a recurring basis such as monthly or annual usage, metered usage or one-time usage.

Payment processing software securely link point of sale, e-commerce, and other capabilities directly to major transaction processors for performing credit, debit, gift card and check transactions. Features include:Automatic processing of payments in real-time for online registrations, enrollments, donations, activities, fees, tickets, purchases, authentication, authorization, fraud check, settlement, tokenizationCollecting, processing and tracking payments from point-of-sale (POS), online, mail-in, in person, kiosksAllow partial payments, set up recurring payments, apply discounts, accept coupons, & process refundsSetting up tax payment processes
Solution to record and manage the sales processed by workforce, affiliates, agents, etc. for the purpose of incentivization

Commerce engine to enable online sales for consumers or customers. Functions include creation and management of Web storefronts, shopping cart, personalization, payment transactions &settlements, product visualization etc. Mature platforms could include specific capabilities (distributed order management, mobile stores, integration with social media, customer account management etc.) and integration with CRM, ERP and SCM systems to enable advanced multichannel sales

Solution set for enabling detailed recording, reporting and tracking of the sales operations and allows performing analysis and evaluation to understand the areas of problems or opportunities for purpose of recommending the plan of action to improve sales performance
Solution suite to manage the creation, review, approval, amendment, audit, and closure of customer bulk and sales orders

Capability to avail integration options to connect with the third- party systems for various operations option depending on level of integration like product registration, demand capture, inventory visibility, etc.

Digital account that enables a consumer/customer to make the electronic payment against the transaction instead of physical currency exchange. Gift cards are pre-purchased cards or monetary rewards to the consumer against which the payments of certain value can be adjusted against the transaction

Capability enabling managing operational activities in the store and in the backroom to manage sales operations like store design, shelf & space management, inbound inventory management, backroom management, etc.

Enables store to manage physical inventories and perform stock counts, manages detailed information about merchandise items, suppliers, containers, and customer orders. Also enables store to raise request for transferring or returning the stock.

Capability to manage decentralized work-time management for the employees covering Workforce management strategies, Store task standards development and Labor scheduling processes, Time & attendance/payroll processes and In-store HR services, Staff recruitment, training and retention processes.

Capability to support detailed management of tasks occurring across the store, including back office, receiving, and customer facing activities. It also includes monitoring of execution to improve efficiencies of staffing and service levels by detailed task management.

Pricing and Ticketing enables retailer in managing printing of shelf edge labels, tickets, barkers, in-store promotions, ad-hoc signs or any other in-store printing requirement. Printing and Ticketing solution works in integrates with the PoS system.

Capability enables management of cash at the Point-of-Sale. Cash Management solutions allow reducing labor, shrinkage and in increasing the cash flow. Cash Management solution connect with the machines which deposit, dispense or recycle cash which would reflect immediately in the retailers’ bank account and affects positively the cash flow level of the organization and provides better control on accepted notes. Capability provides store level reporting as well as consolidated reports accessible at head office level.

Capability enables secure payment method using debit or credit card, smartcard, or another payment device by using RFID technology or near-field communication. This allows customer to tap the payment card near a point-of-sale terminal equipped with the technology.

Capability enables management of order where it can be directly picked up by the customer from the nearest available checkpoint typically a local hub or stores. It allows retailer to schedule pickups, raise inventory requirements, trigger back-office requests for like packaging, etc. to support store pickup, curbside pickup, etc.

Loss Preventions allows to track, analysis, gain control and reduce the shrink of the stores (known and unknown). Also includes raising alerts and triggers incase of deviations for carrying out investigation and tracking it.

Franchise management enables retailers with the information and control they need to run a retail franchise chain. This allows retailers to increase efficiency, improve profitability and communicate more effectively with franchises.

Capability that enables capturing, tracking & fulfilling requests of service requests and complaints. Provides a categorization of requests & identification or responsible teams in the organization. Requests are monitored & escalated if the fulfillment is not finished within a certain timeframe or with the required quality.

Capability enables management of any service request work for the customer, allows customers to schedule appointments and organization to automatically assign the service basis various factors like area of service, type of service requirement, availability of service provider, etc.
Capability enabling retailer organization to measure the performance of the service basis different metrics like time to serve the user, user satisfaction index, time to first response, etc.

Capability ensuring tracking of the warranty of products and manage the returns of merchandise, products and ensure that credit notes are recorded and managed. Returns Management helps organizations improve their operational efficiency by automating the management of returns policies, reducing fraud and providing consumers quicker, easier & more accurate returns, across all channels.
Capability enabling managing the partner organization for purpose of providing support services to customers (like product fix, installation, etc.)

Capabilities required to perform R&D Portfolio Planning by which organizations determine the set of innovation and new product development (NPD) investments they will fund—and those they won’t—to achieve their business objectives. R&D Portfolio Optimization helps organization strategically manage their product portfolio to make the right investment decisions, optimize the value of your portfolio, and allocate the most profitable use of resources.

Capabilities required to manage the process of innovation within an organization right from the point of ideation till the concept is taken for implementation. Includes sub capabilities like Idea sourcing – integrated collaboration, online customer community monitoring and mining, crowd sourcing.

Capability supporting recording of item concepts, ideas, inspirations, and storyboards. Allows incorporating market trends, customer needs & feedback, brand guidelines, and competitor actions into product development process. Tools are leveraged for developing the visual, design and technical aspects of the product (and packaging, labeling, artwork).
Capability to enable development of the product concept into actual product and subsequently managing, planning, scheduling and controlling a product release.
Capability enabling planning, controlling and communicating of the budget of a concept so that its profitability is not compromised.
Capability enables maintaining product data like item technical specifications, component materials, and construction details of a product.
Capability enabling identification, evaluation and onboarding of the supplier for managing the product development for the retailer

Store lifecycle management capability enables retailers to identify profitable new store locations, open and remodel stores on time and within budget, lower costs of contracts and material, minimize leasehold occupancy costs, and reduce costs and improve availability of store facilities and equipment.

Assortment planning enables shelf and item specific assortment capabilities. It supports the following Assortment Management capabilities: Long Life Cycle and Short Life Cycle, E-commerce and Item Management.  Category Management uses demand forecasting to improve merchandise planning processes. It uses business goals, product, location and customer intelligence data to inform the merchandising and planning decision process. Helps determine a customer centric merchandising strategy for each category while providing the lowest cost of goods.

Micro and Macro space planning enables with store-specific space planning, floor planning, shelf planning. It includes: Automation of processes for managing large volumes of floor plans and planograms Defining a product mix yielding higher margins while being merchandised in less space Analytical to optimize store clusters, product selection and shelf presentation in stores

Landed cost management enables tracking and managing to control the actual landed cost of the item purchased from the supplier against the estimated projected planned. Contract management capabilities related to preparing contract related artifacts like vendor negotiations, contract authoring and maintenance.

Capability enabling managing product information in a multichannel and cross-media environment. Enables providing consistent, accurate and up-to-date information to multiple output media such as web sites, print catalog, ERP systems, and electronic data feeds to trading partners. PIM solutions also enables support for multiple geographic locations, multi-lingual data, and maintenance and modification of product information within a centralized catalog.

Capability to manage and optimize product pricing throughout the product life cycle. It includes:  Life Cycle Pricing (Initial Pricing, Promotion and Markdown and Clearance Pricing)  Pricing Strategy (Key Value Item Analysis, Store Zoning Analysis and Market Basket Analysis) Promotion strategy
Capability for defining graphics, fixtures, displays, signage and in-store media for each channel and specifying alternative location displays, cross-merchandising.

Price Optimization focuses on setting the most effective pricing strategies to maximize revenue and profitability. It involves analyzing various factors such as demand elasticity, competitor pricing, inventory levels, and customer behavior to determine the ideal price points for products. It aims to strike a balance between competitive pricing, customer value, and profitability.

The process of setting and managing financial targets for a retailer’s product assortment which involves forecasting sales, expenses, and inventory levels across various product categories over a specific period. This helps to ensure the right product mix is available at the right time. It requires close collaboration between buying teams, finance departments, and inventory managers to optimize resources and profitability and enables businesses to make informed purchasing decisions, control costs, and achieve overall financial objectives while maximizing sales and minimizing financial risks.

This business capability focuses on determining the optimal pricing strategy to maximize profitability and competitiveness. It involves analyzing market trends, customer behavior, and cost factors to set prices that balance demand, margins, and market positioning.

This involves tracking and managing all costs associated with bringing products to market. This includes transportation, customs, duties, taxes, and other logistical expenses that contribute to the final cost of goods. Deal Management focuses on negotiating favorable terms with suppliers and managing promotional deals or discounts. By accurately calculating landed costs and optimizing deal structures, businesses can ensure profitability, control expenses, and make informed pricing and purchasing decisions while maintaining competitive advantage in the market.

Demand management enables controlling and tracking business unit requirements and internal purchasing operations. It helps organizations remain engaged in their supplier relationships and related advantages. Organizations use demand management systems to address external spending factors, arrange purchase orders and eradicate waste.

Allows demand-based allocations of merchandise and optimize the distribution of inventory across all retail locations. Optimizing allocations for each product at the store-size level ensures that the store-level inventory meets customer demand. Capability for balancing inventory with supply chain through forecasting, replenishment planning (Inventory, Store and DC) and demand-based allocations of merchandise. Optimizing allocations for each product at the store-size level ensures that the store-level inventory meets customer demand.

Production planning enables planning of production and manufacturing capacities to utilizes the resource allocation of activities of workers, materials and production capacity, in order to meet the required capacity.

Procurement planning enables managing demand supply gap and perform identification and consolidation of requirements of products or raw material for production by determining the timeframes for procurement with the objective of having the product / raw material at the time when required.

This business capability utilizes predictive analytics to monitor and forecast capacity requirements across various business functions. It ensures that resources are efficiently allocated and potential bottlenecks are identified and addressed proactively, supporting seamless operations and strategic planning.

This capability is a part of Integrated business planning , the S&OP process looks to balance Demand and Supply, and to create an integrated plan for the enterprise that is aligned with its financial targets and strategic objectives. The Execution looks to adjust the supply plan to any sort term variation of the demand plan to ensure customer service levels are maintained and inline with S&OP targets.

Capability required for managing creation, review, approval, amendment, audit, and closure of purchase orders to suppliers. It also includes PO costing, scaling, splitting, investment buys, and electronic communication with vendors, managing ordering constraints such as order frequency, lead time, vendor minimums.

Capability enables keeping track of managing Trade compliance requirements which includes export control and reporting, import clearance, anti-bribery, antitrust and competition, third-party agent vetting and management, supply chain security, and overall assessment and management trade regulatory risk.

Capability that focuses on reconciliation and payment of supplier invoices. It helps perform reviews to resolve any discrepancies identified. Invoices are matched or resolved, then posted with any corresponding documents to Financials. Automation of such capability improves payment cycles and increases productivity.
This business capability assesses the costs associated with sourcing materials, components, or services and negotiate favorable terms and pricing with suppliers.
Capability enables production execution in alignment to customer requests by coordinating materials, machine, methods and man-power, which optimizes inventory, improves quality, and reduces costs.
Capability enabling organization of the delivery of parts to production allowing the customer to optimize both line side material and WIP thus reducing costs and improving quality.

MES enables end to end management of the manufacturing process and provides an information system that connects, monitors and controls complex manufacturing systems and data flows on the factory floor. The main goal of an MES is to ensure effective execution of the manufacturing operations and improve production output.

Ensures that an organization or product is consistent, can be considered to have four main components: quality planning, quality control, quality assurance and quality improvement. Quality management is focused not only on product/service quality, but also the means to achieve it. Quality management therefore uses quality assurance and control of processes as well as products to achieve more consistent quality.

Capability for manufacturing units to manage tracking and maintenance requirements. Allows analyze maintenance costs and determine the proper allocation of resources for tasks such as capacity planning.
Consists of a set of tools, processes, methods, and culture used by firms who develop and manufacture products to ensure that a product meets its profit (or cost) target.

This capability includes processes for managing the environment regulations, health & safety policies for sustainable development of the businesses. Organizations / businesses need to have environmental, health and safety (EHS) programs that integrate with their business Operations to maintain compliance.

This capability deals with the sustainable manufacturing which is a crucial approach that aims to minimize negative environmental impacts within the manufacturing industry while conserving energy and natural resources. Objectives include minimizing negative Impacts wherein sustainable manufacturing seeks to reduce harm to the environment by minimizing waste, pollution, and resource depletion. Other objectives include energy conservation which is efficient use of energy resources is a key focus, natural resource preservation where the goal is to protect and conserve natural resources and safety enhancement that deals with sustainable practices also enhance employee, community and product safety.

Capability that supports planning and management of inventory to meet customer demand commitments. It includes inventory planning at each stage of the supply chain like stock to be managed, flow of inventory, time of inventory replenishment and movement, etc.

Capability to integrate different supply chain capabilities in the organization like Production management, warehouse management, logistics to provide end to end visibility of inventory at different stages of the value chain and across different touchpoints like stores, DC, Warehouse, in transit, etc.

Vendor-managed inventory (VMI) enables buyer of a product (business) provide information to a vendor (supply chain) supplier of that product and the supplier takes full responsibility for maintaining an agreed inventory of the material, usually at the buyer's consumption location.

Capability enabling optimization of the order fulfillment across the channels so orders arrive to customers in promised time while also ensuring the lowest possible cost incurred to manage fulfillment. Organization with a significant amount of customers and product sourcing locations can fulfill customer orders more efficiently and profitably. The organization selects the appropriate sourcing location to fill the customer orders received from the multiple channels of order placement. Allows organization to improve customer service levels and inventory performance through flexible fulfillment and application of Available to Promise methods.
Capability that leverages analytics capability to manage, process and sell returned and excess inventory. It allows determining the options for each item, maximizing recovery value and reducing cost.

Omnichannel Fulfillment refers to the seamless integration of multiple sales channels to deliver products to customers in the most efficient way possible. This approach allows retailers to fulfill orders from various touchpoints, whether it’s shipping from a warehouse, retail store, or through direct delivery services. It ensures real-time inventory visibility, streamlined order processing, and faster delivery times, enhancing the customer experience.

Transportation management enables network planning and transportation scheduling activities, e.g. Consolidate orders & optimize shipments across the supply chain to maximize return on transportation costs Inbound and outbound logistics, Route Optimization and Cross-Docking Schedule transportation/vehicles and Manage and tracking vehicles
Capability to manage assets and fleets for transportation and optimizing their selection based on material handling requirements including route optimization to minimize overall cost.
Capability enabling management of warehouse operations including inbound and outbound processing, facility management and storage, physical inventory, and planned and opportunistic cross docking.
Yard management capability enable organization to coordinate and track truck movements within the yard, before, during and after loading/unloading.

Capability to manage planning for labor needs of the facility based on upcoming labor needs and required labor skill sets. It also includes setting the necessary labor level by scheduling of employee time.

Capability enabling carrying out physical inspection of the material against set thresholds by which quality is measured and ensuring that the product meets these pre-set quality standards. Includes capturing the information to measure the performance level of the consignment received.

Capability to manage the scheduling & tracking of packaging and assembling products to be sold as a ‘package’. This capability leverages order management capability information to provide instructions on packages to be assembled basis scheduled order deliveries.

Capabilities to manage delivery of the product to the end consumers in the last leg of the order fulfillment journey. Supports capabilities for both scheduling and managing the order delivery to the designated location or self-pickup of the order from the defined spots like Stores, pickup centers, DCs, etc.

Capability to manage collaboration with both customers and supply chain partners. It gives 3PLs more visibility into the business operations of their customers, so to better plan the operations resulting in better service and increased efficiency for the customers.

Capabilities includes management of import purchase orders including duty calculations, import purchase order attributes, letters of credit, estimated landed cost calculation. It also includes import logistics tracking to provide visibility to import movements (e.g. booking, bill of lading, etc.), monitoring production, and managing production timing and actions for private label products.
Capability enabling automated storage and retrieval of the material in the warehouse, from defined storage locations, by using computer-controlled systems integrated with warehouse management system.

Capability enabling tracking and tracing of the product back to any origination point capturing all the stages of the supply chain, including planning, procurement, storage, transportation and distribution.

The process of moving goods from the customer back to the retailer or manufacturer, often due to returns, repairs, recycling, or disposal.This process is essential for handling customer returns, managing defective or unsold goods, and ensuring products are properly refurbished or recycled. It involves tasks like processing returns, restocking items, or managing warranties. Effective reverse logistics systems help retailers recover value from returned or unsold products, reduce waste, and maintain customer satisfaction

Dropshipping is a retail fulfillment method where the store owner doesn't keep products in stock. when a customer places an order, the retailer purchases the item from a third-party supplier who ships it directly to the customer. This model eliminates the need for inventory management, warehousing, and shipping logistics, making it an attractive option for entrepreneurs.
Capability enabling managing the supplier interaction like pricing, contracts, supplier performance, placing order, managing settlements, etc.

Capability required to keep track of and manage vendor compliance requirements inline to defined rules. It enables organization to measure and maintain suppliers' compliance with statutory, legal, and technical requirements.
This business capability aims at integrating sustainable practices into the sourcing and production processes.
This business capability aims at identifying, evaluating, and selecting suppliers who can meet the organization's sourcing and production needs.
Gen AI assited negotiations
This business capability ensures products and processes meet established quality standards, industry regulations, and compliance requirements.

Financial accounting (balance sheets, income statements, cash flow statements & statements of shareholders’ equity) for investors and the public. It typically follows accounting standards (US GAAP or IFRS).
Track and manage Revenue and cost to understand profitability and cost efficiancy
Controlling, Overhead Management, Budgeting, Product Costing, Profit Analysis, Consolidation and end-of accounting
Tax Reporting & Compliance enables capability for managing the tax matters and ensuring compliance across all taxes, tax reporting and statutory accounting.

Treasury management capability manages organization’s holdings, with the objective to manage the firm's liquidity and mitigating its operational, financial and reputational risk. It involves treasury cash management, treasury hedging and compliance.

Invoice to Pay  involves managing supplier invoices for goods and services, validating them against purchase orders and delivery receipts, and ensuring timely payments. This process helps retailers maintain cash flow, ensure accurate financial records, and strengthen supplier partnerships.

Receivables Management focuses on efficiently tracking and collecting payments from customers for goods and services sold on credit. It involves optimizing cash flow, reducing overdue accounts, and ensuring timely payments to support liquidity and financial stability, while maintaining strong customer relationships.
Capability enables complete management of necessary employee related processes like Time and Holidays, Employee concerns, Payroll, Employee self service, Employee guidelines, etc.

Capability enables management of entire span the entire policy process from creation, to update of, management of, and communication of portals to automated knowledge assessment and certification of policy understanding as well as reporting and audit.

Recruitment management capability enables organization carry out end to end talent recruitment process which involves identification of a needs for an employee, advertising of the job, selection of interview candidates, posting of job offers, resource on-boarding, etc.

Compensation Management facilitates the payment of employees, payroll necessities and bonus payments based on performance management. Includes generation of pay slips for employees, monthly bank transfers into accounts, etc. Solution supporting this capability is integrated with the core HR systems to allow up to date information based on performance management and salary information.

Training and Development enables capability require to enable training and learning environment for employee, for example, a training portal where virtual learning courses are available for all employees and development can be tracked on an ongoing basis.

Journey Management focuses on optimizing the end-to-end employee experience, from recruitment to onboarding, development, and retention. It leverages technology to streamline HR processes, improve engagement, and enhance productivity, ultimately driving talent satisfaction and organizational performance.

Compliance management helps manage organization's adherence to regulatory guidelines. Audit reports evaluate the strength and thoroughness of compliance preparations, security policies, user access controls and risk management procedures over the course of a compliance audit.
This business capability refers to a strategy for managing an organization's overall governance, enterprise risk management and compliance with regulations.
Enables organization to manage activities related to defining, monitoring and minimizing the effects of different types of risk on an organization's brand, capital and earnings.

Enterprise legal management (ELM) enables in-house legal departments to handle their operations. In-house legal professionals use enterprise legal management tools to manage legal spend, keep an electronic database of legal records, and generate reports with analytics related to legal activity. Corporate legal departments use enterprise legal management solutions to maintain a holistic view of their activities, control legal spending, and manage an electronic legal record repository.

Ensures alignment between business objectives, compliance, and risk management across all corporate services. It establishes policies, frameworks, and controls to optimize decision-making, regulatory compliance, and strategic execution, safeguarding the organization’s integrity and long-term success.

This business capability covers crucial components of a company’s performance management, which ensures the need to create an insightful financial plan to establish accessible, company-befitting short-term, and long-term goals.

EPM system enables organization to tag and keep track of the key value KPIs for organization to measure its performance. It enables with capabilities like  - Budgeting, planning, forecasting,  - Consolidation of the results - Performance analysis Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) such as sales, overhead and operating costs as well as the Return on Investment (ROI) are generally used for planning, measuring and analyzing performance.

Focuses on optimizing, automating, and aligning core business processes to enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and improve customer experiences. By continuously monitoring and refining workflows across functions like inventory, sales, and customer service, BPM drives operational excellence and supports agile decision-making to maintain competitive advantage.

Enterprise Strategy defines the long-term vision, goals, and initiatives that guide the organization’s growth, competitive positioning, and market expansion. It aligns business operations, technology, and resources to drive innovation, profitability, and customer-centric outcomes in a rapidly evolving industry.

Property Lifecycle management system enables end to end management of the assets / property like land, machine, etc. through its lifespan from the point of procurement to the point of disposal or transfer of the asset / property.

Facilities Service Management provides the technology enabling the most effective management of services at facilities, enabling all issues to be dealt with in a timely manner and allow employees to focus on working, rather than dealing with facilities issues. May include: Logging of non important issues Contacting relevant maintenance, cleaning or safety teams in the event of an urgent facilities issue Catering and other services provided within the facility

Capability involves maintaining and operating physical spaces, such as stores, warehouses, and distribution centers, to ensure a safe, efficient, and customer-friendly environment. This includes managing building maintenance, energy use, security, and health and safety protocols. Its goal is to optimize the store's operations, improve the customer experience, and reduce operational disruptions.

Capabiltiy involves acquiring, leasing, and maintaining physical retail locations, warehouses, and offices to support business operations. It includes site selection, lease management, space optimization, and compliance with regulations. The goal is to ensure efficient use of space, cost control, and alignment with business objectives.

Capability focuses on overseeing and managing the technology systems that support operations, such as networks, servers, and data storage. It includes monitoring performance, ensuring system reliability, and maintaining security. The goal is to optimize technology resources, prevent downtime, and ensure smooth retail operations.

Capability for organization to manage purchase of operating resources to enable its business. It’s comprised of a wide variety of goods and services, from standardized low value items to complex and costly products and services.

Aligns Tech architecture and plans with the business priorities and ensures that resources are deployed appropriately to fulfil approved demand for Tech services. Develops Tech services that provide sustainable value to the business by maximizing benefits and minimizing one-off and ongoing delivery risk. 'Capability to manage portfolio of different IT projects organization has taken up to support business objectives. Portfolio Optimization helps organization strategically manage product portfolio to make the right investment decisions, optimize the value of your portfolio, and allocate the most profitable use of resources.

ITSM tools enables standardization and digitization of the IT Service Management processes. Key features of the ITSM tools include incident management, service request management, problem management, change management, and service fulfillment processes to make the service delivery.

Enterprise architecture (EA) tools enable enterprise architects and other business & IT stakeholders manage consolidated information across business, information, solution and technology domains, along with other relevant architectural viewpoints. This information aides in the investment, development and delivery of IT solutions that enable business success.

Capability involves managing and ensuring compliance with software and technology licenses across the organization. It includes tracking, renewing, and auditing licenses to avoid legal risks and optimize usage. The goal is to ensure the organization adheres to licensing agreements while controlling costs and usage efficiency.

Capability focuses on protecting the retail enterprise’s IT infrastructure, data, and systems from security threats. It involves implementing comprehensive security policies, risk management practices, and monitoring systems to safeguard against cyberattacks, data breaches, and unauthorized access. This capability ensures the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of enterprise assets while maintaining compliance with industry regulations.

Focused on designing and integrating technology solutions that align with business objectives, ensuring scalability, flexibility, and efficiency. It leverages emerging technologies to create cohesive, customer-centric systems that drive innovation, optimize operations, and enhance the retail experience across all channels.

Focuses on ensuring the quality and reliability of technology systems and applications. It involves testing, identifying defects, and improving processes to meet performance and functionality standards. The goal is to deliver high-quality solutions that support smooth retail operations and customer experiences.

This capability focuses on designing, developing, and implementing scalable, secure, and efficient technology solutions that support retail operations. This includes system architecture, software development, infrastructure management, and automation. Engineers also ensure system integration, security, and continuous innovation to optimize enterprise performance and customer experiences.

Focuses on driving and overseeing the strategic transformation initiatives across the retail enterprise. It ensures alignment of technology projects with business objectives, managing change, and fostering innovation. This includes prioritizing digital transformation efforts, monitoring progress, and ensuring successful execution of technology-driven business improvements. The office also supports cross-functional collaboration to achieve long-term growth and operational efficiency.

Capability focuses on building a robust security culture and designing secure IT architectures within the retail enterprise. It involves educating employees on security best practices, promoting vigilance against threats, and ensuring that systems are architected with strong security controls. This capability ensures proactive threat mitigation, compliance, and the integration of security into every aspect of technology infrastructure and operations.

Capability focuses on monitoring, detecting, and responding to security threats in real-time across the retail enterprise. It involves managing security tools, incident response processes, and coordinating efforts to identify vulnerabilities and mitigate risks. This capability ensures continuous protection of enterprise systems, data, and networks while maintaining compliance with security policies and regulations.

Capability within Security Operations Management focuses on ensuring the security of software applications throughout their lifecycle. This involves identifying and mitigating vulnerabilities in applications, implementing secure coding practices, and conducting regular security assessments. It ensures that applications used across the  enterprise are protected from cyber threats, maintaining data integrity and customer trust.

This business capability leverages artificial intelligence to enhance the selection and management of customers and vendors. It uses advanced algorithms and data analysis to identify and prioritize high-value relationships, improving decision-making and optimizing resource allocation.
Data modeling capability is responsible defining data entities and their interrelations across the business processes
Middleware services integrates of all major solutions within the organization and with external partners for purpose of seamless information exchange.
Data Governance enables defining and managing the processes, procedures, roles and responsibilities that guide overall management of an organization’s data​.

Enables organization to protect data from unauthorized access, viewing, modification or deletion - whether the intent is accidental, intentional or malicious. ​Data Security includes:​  Compliance and security policies Adherence to local, national and international laws Alignment with corporate security and audit Data-centric security tools and technologies​ Establishing data audit trails

Data quality monitoring ensures data quality on each data instance created, utilized and maintained within an organization. It is enabled by enterprise quality monitoring process that routinely monitors, maintains and ensures the data quality standards across the data management system within an enterprise.
Data lineage enables tracking of the data entities from its creation through its transformations over time. It identifies dataset's origin, movement, characteristics and quality.

Master Data Management, enabling enterprise-wide consolidation of foundational business data including customers, products, suppliers, sites, employees and key performance indicators.  MDM should provide definitions of data elements (e.g., product, customer) across all channels including third parties via standardized end-to-end, full life-cycle processes defining SLAs and operations policies/procedures for data QA and governance.

Information describing various aspects of data asset, improving the usability through its life cycle. Key components of Metadata Management includes Metadata Strategy, Metadata Capture and Storage, Metadata Integration, Publication.

Focuses on ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of transaction-related data across the retail enterprise. This includes managing and synchronizing data from sales, payments, inventory movements, and customer interactions. It ensures seamless, real-time access to reliable transactional data, enabling informed decision-making and smooth operations across all retail systems.

Focuses on managing supplementary data that supports core business operations but is not part of primary transactional or master data. This includes data related to marketing campaigns, customer interactions, and external sources like third-party feeds. It ensures this data is accurately captured, integrated, and accessible, enabling comprehensive analytics and informed decision-making across the retail enterprise.

Data Warehouse is a tech solution which enables organization to manage cleansed and harmonized data, accessible across the entire enterprise to enable actionable insights and cross-functional leverage. It is supported by robust multi-dimensional reporting tools to query, tabulate, and visualize data.

Enables repository of data stored in its natural/raw format, usually object blobs or files. A data lake is usually a single store of all enterprise data including raw copies of source system data and transformed data used for tasks such as reporting, visualization, advanced analytics, and machine learning. A data lake can include structured data from relational databases (rows and columns), semi-structured data (CSV, logs, XML, JSON), unstructured data (emails, documents, PDFs), and binary data (images, audio, video).

Capability that enables to manage the storage of the data in different forms with different processing / access requirements in different storage vaults and processing engines to churn the data for requirements of performing analysis for deriving business insights.

Capability involves systematic management and optimization of knowledge assets within the retail enterprise. This includes organizing, storing, and sharing critical business information, best practices, and insights across teams. It ensures efficient knowledge transfer, fosters collaboration, and enhances decision-making by providing easy access to relevant, up-to-date information for employees at all levels.

Market Insight capability enables collecting publicly available information about market, competition and individuals from a variety of sources. This analysis enables with complete view of current and potential customers, identifies market opportunities, and informs decision-making.

capabilities.l3_name: 9.1.2 Customer & Behavioral Analytics/ Customer Profitability Analytics / Customer Lifetime Value Prediction
capabilities.description: Customer analytics provides the capability to collect, organize and analyze market and key competitor information to support marketing initiatives such as loyalty programs, product promotions, product transitions, new product development and pricing, cross-selling and up-selling campaigns, and customized one-to-one marketing. Analytics capability that provide an in-depth understanding of customers, segmentation, preferences and trends that will in turn enable an organization to perform channel, customer & shopper strategies, and drive product innovation. Covers Customer Profiling, Lifetime Value Modeling, Propensity Modeling, Churn Modeling.

Store Traffic Analytics enable retailers to evaluate sales potential to a customer and help establish customer service and marketing strategies for maximizing the profit. Analysis of this data provides retail with insight on consumer shopping and purchasing behavior, as well as can provide insights into sales performance during high and low traffic periods for each store.

Analytics solutions that examine profitability to find the most profitable products, customers and sales channels. It provides features like what-if scenario modeling, strategy evaluation, test assumptions and compare current performance with historical actual and external benchmarks. Forward-looking financial analysis can help guide sales, marketing, and supply chain functions to optimally deploy resources toward the most profitable opportunities

Capability to analyze key channels where user generated content is most relevant and most influencing target segment positively or negatively. To listen, measure and report on user's feedback on products to enable feed into new /existing products design/redesign and enhance shopping experience.Social media analytics includes number of specialized analysis techniques, such as social filtering, social network analysis, sentiment analysis and social media analytics.

Analytics capability that enable firms to optimize the portfolio of their products on the store shelves to maximize the market share / revenues / profits while reducing complexity to manufacture, distribute and sell the products.

Enables scientific analysis of marketing strategies to reallocate marketing investment to increase efficiency of marketing spend. Includes allocation of marketing investment across geographies, categories, brands, and channels.
Capability enabling the tracking for improving the ROI and effectiveness of marketing. It encompasses the planning process, performance measurement and establishment of predictive analytics.

Capability focuses on the systematic management and optimization of knowledge assets within the retail enterprise. This includes organizing, storing, and sharing critical business information, best practices, and insights across teams. It ensures efficient knowledge transfer, fosters collaboration, and enhances decision-making by providing easy access to relevant, up-to-date information for employees at all levels.

Capability to automate labor planning, scheduling and time keeping for store and warehouse management. Provides greater visibility to store-level scheduling practices. Advanced time and labor (T&L) optimization incorporates many factors, including capacity, staff availability and budget constraints, to produce a schedule that maximizes store efficiency and compliance to labor laws, while minimizing budget variance.

Technology platforms using predictive and descriptive modeling to reduce business exposure to fraud like fraudulent transactions (both offline and online), identity theft etc. The solutions help reduce fraud risk analyzing records on businesses and individuals to uncover relevant information for better informed decision-making.

Focuses on tracking and analyzing product performance throughout its entire lifecycle, from development to end-of-life. It involves gathering data on sales trends, customer feedback, and inventory levels to optimize product offerings and identify opportunities for improvement. This capability enables informed decisions about product strategies, pricing, and resource allocation, ensuring alignment with customer needs and market demands.

Capability enabling enterprise wide access to commercial department dashboards to drive KPI based decision making. Allows business to generate reports, access dashboards, and manage web-intelligence portals.
Capability to provide insight needed to ensure optimum planning and execution of transportation / logistics related activities of a retail firm.

Retail replenishment analytics helps retailers improve inventory management processes with automated, optimized replenishment control and constraint settings that address inventory availability issues throughout the connected supply chain.

Focuses on analyzing and optimizing the end-to-end fulfillment process, from order processing to delivery. It involves tracking key metrics like order accuracy, shipping times, inventory levels, and customer satisfaction to identify bottlenecks and improve efficiency. This capability helps enhance operational performance, reduce costs, and ensure timely and accurate deliveries, improving the overall customer experience.

Capability to manage the right amount of inventory to meet the target service levels while tying up a minimum amount of capital in inventory. To achieve this, you need to account for both supply and demand volatility. Key elements which allows optimization of the inventory includes Demand forecasting, Inventory policy and Replenishment management.

Supply chain network optimization enables to run multiple “what-if” scenarios to develop concise, strategic plans and goals based on sound metrics. It can reduce overall supply chain costs, optimize distribution process and transportation requirement, reduce inventory requirement, Enhance profit margins and Improve flexibility

Capability enabling spend visibility that helps identify opportunities to reduce costs. Ability to monitor, analyze and improve supplier performance; benchmarking against external standards and industry best-practice helps lower spend.

Focuses on tracking and analyzing the environmental and social impact of supply chain operations. It includes measuring carbon footprints, waste reduction, and resource efficiency across sourcing, production, and distribution. This capability helps the retail enterprise make data-driven decisions to improve sustainability, reduce environmental impact, and align with corporate social responsibility goals.

Enables retailer to analyze and optimize the way they use their macro (product category level) and the micro (item level within product category) space in a retail store to align both space and assortment with customer demand. Provides a merchandised floor plans (Planograms/CAD drawings) that show locations of the fixtures with the product categories and an analytic capability to optimize return on space and performance. Also enables retailer to revise segments and categories, adjust macro space, redesign and prototype stores effectively.

Optimization solution combines price, promotion and markdown to use predictive analytics and optimization capabilities to plan and manage every aspect of pricing (regular, promotion and markdown) throughout the life cycle of an item. Some of the capabilities include - Monitor and analyze the actual effects of pricing decisions across products, markets, segments, regions, and promotion periods/ Price change testing / “what-if” analysis, Monitor price trends and competitive actions, Provide total profitability analytics (unit cost, cost to serve/sell, “should cost”) and customer value analytics (willingness to pay, price sensitivity, response modelling).

Capability to improve the merchandise planning processes through advance demand forecasting and analyzing business goals, product, location and customer intelligence data. Enables decision making in optimization areas: assortment / allocation and space Replenishment, Price, promotion and markdown, size/pack.This helps to adjust assortments by store or cluster, determine buy quantities, optimize space allocation and planograms, and maximize product allocation and availability.
Enables setting up flexible pricing for the product which can determined be configuring / considering various factors like demand, availability, margin requirements, etc.
Enterprise Analytics and Business Intelligence deals with enabling organization to collect, analyze and process analytical data to generate insights for the business.

Data Visualization offers capabilities, such as dynamic data content, visual querying, multiple-dimension linked visualization, animated visualization, personalization, and business-actionable alerts.

Advanced Analytics is the usage of sophisticated statistical techniques and tools, typically complex in nature compared to traditional BI, to discover deeper insights and make predictions for business recommendations.

Enables monitoring of the data patterns to detect statistical variations and trigger an alert whenever there is an anomaly. These alerts can be either automatic or custom. Further, these alerts may also trigger business rules in the Business Rule Engine or Complex Event Processing Systems.

Focuses on analyzing data to identify opportunities for business expansion and revenue growth. It involves tracking key performance indicators (KPIs) such as market trends, customer acquisition, and sales performance. This capability enables the retail enterprise to make informed decisions, optimize strategies, and drive sustainable growth through targeted investments and initiatives.

capabilities.l3_name: 9.7.2 Financial Controlling & Reporting Analytics /  Financial Modelling & Analytics
capabilities.description: Focuses on providing data-driven insights for effective financial management and reporting. It involves tracking key financial metrics, such as revenue, costs, profitability, and budget compliance, to ensure alignment with business objectives. This capability enables accurate, real-time financial reporting, supports strategic decision-making, and ensures transparency and compliance across the retail enterprise.

Focuses on leveraging data to optimize human resource management and improve employee performance. It involves analyzing metrics such as employee engagement, retention, productivity, and recruitment effectiveness. This capability helps the retail enterprise make data-driven decisions to enhance workforce strategies, optimize talent management, and align human resources with business objectives.

This business capability uses predictive analytics to estimate the long-term value of customers. It helps identify high-value customers, optimize marketing strategies, and tailor engagement efforts to maximize customer retention and profitability.

This business capability predicts product returns by analyzing customer behavior, product characteristics, and transaction data. It enables proactive measures to reduce return rates, improve product quality, and enhance customer satisfaction.

Focuses on analyzing data related to the performance, efficiency, and reliability of IT systems and infrastructure. It involves monitoring key metrics such as system uptime, response times, resource utilization, and security events. This capability enables the retail enterprise to optimize IT operations, improve service delivery, and align technology investments with business goals for better overall performance.
